D has units rate squared. The source reconstructs a coupling bound TV(P_visible,P_predictor)<=min{1,delta_init+T sqrt((k-1)D)} for the entire visible path including jump times. No stationary distribution, hidden dimension, minimum label mass or training/deployment density ratio is supplied. This is an internally proved source candidate, not physical validation.
